_enabledPluginsComment: HIMMEL-2733 two-tier profile. This map carries the ALWAYS tier (`true` — installed AND enabled on every himmel machine) plus every spec the installers must NOT enable (`false`). A `false` entry is one of two things, and `onDemandPlugins` below is what tells them apart: a spec LISTED there is the ON-DEMAND tier (installed by the installers, written here as `false`, reachable via `/profile enable <spec>`); a spec absent from it is simply NOT INSTALLED. Keep every on-demand spec present here as `false` — reconcile-enabled-plugins.sh writes this map verbatim, so an omitted spec would be appended as false anyway, and the presence-verify in install-plugins.sh reads this key.
_onDemandPluginsComment: HIMMEL-2733 ON-DEMAND tier: INSTALLED by install-plugins.sh but left DISABLED, so the plugin is reachable (`/profile enable <spec>`, or a cadence's own force-enable fragment) without costing session-start context on every launch. `neededBy` names WHO wants it, so discovery can say 'enable X for Y'. Every key here MUST also appear in enabledPlugins as `false` (check-template-himmel-plugins.sh enforces that), and its marketplace MUST be in extraKnownMarketplaces.

context7@claude-plugins-official.neededBy: /find-docs and the context7-mcp skill — live library/API documentation lookups.

typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official.neededBy: TypeScript/JS work in this checkout (scripts/jira, marketplace/plugins/claude-hud) — go-to-definition and diagnostics.

playwright@claude-plugins-official.neededBy: Browser-driven e2e work; the /run skill's browser-driven fallback.

claude-obsidian@himmel.neededBy: The obsidian-vault MCP used by the obsidian-second-brain skill and /obsidian-health. Disabling the plugin is what disables that MCP.

obsidian-triage@himmel.neededBy: /luna-ingest and the luna clip pipeline. The pipeline does NOT need it enabled here: scripts/luna/pipeline-cadence.sh force-enables it per run via a settings fragment (HIMMEL-1036), which is why it is safe on this tier.

telegram-himmel@himmel.neededBy: The telegram MCP behind /telegram-clip and the Telegram connector legs. Disabling the plugin is what disables that MCP.

codex@openai-codex.neededBy: The codex adversarial critic lane. scripts/cr/codex-adv-kickoff.sh resolves this plugin's CACHED companion (~/.claude/plugins/cache/openai-codex/*/codex-companion.mjs) by glob and degrades the lane to 'skipped' when the cache is absent (HIMMEL-2707) — so the lane needs the plugin INSTALLED, never enabled.

_onDemandConnectorsComment: HIMMEL-2733: on-demand capabilities himmel does NOT install and therefore cannot ship a disabled state for — they are per-machine toggles in the Chrome extension and in claude.ai's connector settings. Listed here so the tier is DISCOVERABLE and the install summary can name them; no installer reads this key to write anything.

claude-in-chrome.neededBy: The claude-in-chrome skill and its mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools (browser automation).
claude-in-chrome.enableVia: Chrome extension → per-site permissions. Not installed or configured by himmel.

google-workspace.neededBy: Gmail / Drive / Calendar lookups from a Claude session.
google-workspace.enableVia: claude.ai → Settings → Connectors. Not installed or configured by himmel.
